# Phronesis

> The decision-assurance layer for the agentic economy: the neutral substrate an AI agent
> calls before it acts, to turn intent, evidence, and a calibrated forecast into an auditable
> Decision Asset it can cite, reuse, dispute, and settle against. Phronesis sits downstream of
> the identity and payment rails and consumes them; it certifies the one thing they can't —
> whether the action was defensible. The atomic product is the Decision Asset. Market Memory —
> the resolved-outcome calibration ledger — is the moat. Semantic parity across REST and MCP; transport-appropriate projection.
> A calibration statement needs at least ten resolved records per series, expected about January 2027; current counts are on the scorecard. Pre-revenue.

Phronesis is built for AI agents as much as humans. The transports carry semantic parity: an MCP server
and a REST API, both passing through the same deny-by-default action gate. Agents discover,
evaluate, call, and verify Phronesis Decision Assets programmatically. Phronesis never acts —
it returns an action boundary and an auditable record; the agent and its principal keep the
decision.

Decision Deployment — one design partner at a time: https://phronesisintel.com/deploy (inquiry by the form, or by the MCP tool `engagement_inquiry`).

## One motion, proven first where the stakes are sharpest
One motion — the agent calls Phronesis before a consequential action. Proven first on the
Power-to-Compute Decision Monitor (the energy × compute decisions straining the grid as AI
scales). The platform stands twelve applied verticals on one shared substrate, but the
calibration substance concentrates where decisions resolve first — today, grid-compute. The
breadth is not twelve finished products; it is one motion accumulating a cross-archetype
record (deadline-risk, counterparty-risk, capacity-constraint, regulatory-timing) no
single-vertical tool can match.

V#13 General — any consequential decision, in any domain: the caller brings the proposed action, a frozen resolution rule and a resolution source; Phronesis captures, anchors, resolves and scores. Catalogued; mints on the customer mint path. Proven first on grid-compute.

## Endpoints
- [API base](https://api.phronesisintel.com): REST surface — production base URL.
- [MCP server](https://api.phronesisintel.com/mcp): Model Context Protocol transport with semantic parity to REST.
- [Catalog](https://api.phronesisintel.com/v1/catalog): the vertical inventory + per-vertical archetypes (public).
- [Pricing](https://api.phronesisintel.com/v1/pricing): tier surface (public).
- [Decision API](https://api.phronesisintel.com/v1/decision/forecast): POST a proposed action + context; receive a Decision Asset — forecast distribution, evidence graph, evidence-maturity, an action boundary, and a content-addressed Decision Receipt. JWT-gated.

## Verification
- [Decision Quality Bench / Scorecard](https://api.phronesisintel.com/scorecard.json): measurable today — identifiability (P-ID), immutability (P-IMM), evidence-maturity (P-EVD), baseline-presence (P-BASE). Calibration (P-CAL), action-boundary correctness (P-ACT), baseline-beating (P-BBL) activate as outcomes resolve (~Jan 2027). Where a number isn't earned, the Bench shows a blank it can defend — not a manufactured score.
- [Trust Receipt](https://api.phronesisintel.com/v1/trust/receipt/): per-decision verifiability artifact — the basis for Proof of Decision.

## Agent discovery
- [agent-discovery.json](https://api.phronesisintel.com/.well-known/agent-discovery.json): service identity + capability summary.
- agents.txt · agentic-commerce.json · the .well-known discovery vectors.

## Integration

- [API contract spec](https://phronesisintel.com/spec): the Hermes contract-v1 response shapes.
- [OpenAPI](https://api.phronesisintel.com/.well-known/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 spec.

## Phronesis Register License v1.0
**1. What this covers.** This license applies to the records, scores, legends, summaries and pages that Phronesis publishes on its public register at phronesisintel.com and api.phronesisintel.com (**"Published Records"**). It does not apply to Decision Assets minted at a customer's request, which are governed by the customer's terms and that record's `data_rights`, nor to use of the Phronesis API, which is governed by the Terms of Service.

**2. What you may do, free of charge, with attribution.** You may (a) read Published Records; (b) quote any single Published Record in full and quote or excerpt Published Records in any work, with attribution; (c) cite and link to Published Records; (d) index Published Records for search and use them in search results and in AI-generated answers, with attribution; and (e) use Published Records to train, fine-tune or evaluate machine-learning models, with attribution in your model documentation or data statement, for so long as the machine-readable license declaration published with this register states that such use is permitted. Phronesis may change that declaration at any time for future use.

The Phronesis Register License v1.0 governs this register: reading, quoting, citing, retrieval and training are permitted with attribution and a link; bulk redistribution, mirroring and dataset compilation are not; derivative scoring, ranking or repackaging requires a written license. Terms: https://phronesisintel.com/license

## What's live vs forward (honest)
- Live: the production platform; the deny-by-default, independently red-teamed action gate; the Decision Asset + Receipt; agent-discoverable surfaces; the public Decision Quality Bench (pre-resolution measures); the OAuth-consent connector (read-only open tier).
- Forward (labeled): the calibration record (honest-empty until ~Jan 2027); local/offline assurance nodes.
